id./param/scenario/cs/b_040_cs_050.pack|cs_: "Ho ho ho. How surprising. A human comes plodding before the great Avarith...
"You're the naughty monster who attacked Phnom Nonh! Free the villagers!
"Ho ho ho. You came all this way, at such risk, for that? What fools.
"...Very well. In honor of your foolish courage, I shall free the villagers!
"But... do not think you'll go home free. Nothing is free.
"Give me your most precious thing and I'll free them. Not a bad deal, is it?
"I won't let {var:1} lose anything precious again. This is my cue.
"The very precious thing I've kept warm for so long... I'll give it to this monster.
"Ho ho ho! How understanding for a human! Then I'll take it.
"O-Oh! What a fragrant scent...! This is...!
"You've angered me... A fool who dares mock the great Avarith so...
{var:1} and the party were sealed from casting spells!
"Cry and beg, I'll never forgive you! I'll take your precious lives by force!"
